name: @polaris/agent-runtime
description: Coding-agent runtime: drives an agent over a checked-out repository with a git/GitHub tool server. Runs in a GitHub Actions job, on a Polaris runner, or in a container on the Polaris box.

scripts.build: tsup --entry.shared external.ts --entry.control internal/index.ts --format esm --dts --clean --out-dir dist && node esbuild.config.js

//: The agent CLIs (@anthropic-ai/claude-code, opencode-ai, agent-browser, skills) are NOT imported. utils/install.ts reads their version from this file and installs them into the run's workspace, so these entries are version pins and removing one breaks the run rather than the build.
